与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:欧文的经历、感受与成长。

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Owen keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. People around Owen often share different ideas about the ticket office. In fact, the ball bounced off the backboard and missed the rim.
Owen is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. On Sunday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, left luggage costs five pounds a day.

Ben and Owen are preparing a report about the ticket office. Little by little, things began to change. The bus stop has become an important part of daily life. For example, I had a boiled egg and toast for breakfast.
The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, his voice shook with anger.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Owen thanked Ben for the honest advice. Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
